atoms.text: The remote community of Chambamontera in Peru relies mostly on farming to support itself. Due to its isolated location and challenging landscape, it has been impossible to build a traditional electricity grid.
atoms.sound: The remote community of Chammba-montera in Peru relies mostly on farming to support itself. Due to its isolated location and challenging landscape, it has been impossible to build a traditional electricity grid.

atoms.text: This lack of electricity has slowed down the community’s development and added to the widespread poverty in the region. To solve this problem, a micro-hydro scheme was introduced with the help of local charities.
Through this scheme, the community was able to use the high rainfall and fast-flowing rivers in the region to generate hydro-power.
